compiled_state.title: test-per-branch-review.sh contains 8+ source-file-grepping test anti-patterns (Rule 3 violation)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Severity: P3

## Problem
`tests/workflows/test-per-branch-review.sh` contains multiple grep/awk-based assertions against the workflow YAML source file:
- test_trigger_has_story_pattern
- test_concurrency_group_has_sprint_session_id
- test_cancel_in_progress_true
- test_job_fetches_session_branch
- test_job_calls_ci_llm_review_runner
- test_job_computes_merge_base
- test_job_installs_litellm
- test_mirror_tracker_defenses_job_exists
- test_review_needs_mirror_tracker_defenses
- test_workflow_invokes_resolve_base_script
- test_workflow_emits_suspicious_diff_warning

These all violate behavioral-testing-standard Rule 3 (Execute, don't inspect). The actual gating semantics are validated by GitHub Actions runtime + actionlint static check.

PR #197 surfaced this via critical findings on 3 new tests of the same pattern; those were deleted (commit 7fe8e16b0d) but the pre-existing tests remain.

## Suggested resolution
Replace each text-greppy assertion with either:
- A behavioral test invoking `act` or a workflow-runner mock
- Removal (relying on actionlint + runtime to catch regressions)

Deciding per-test which approach fits requires care; prefer removal where actionlint + runtime checks are sufficient.

- Parent bug da45-7d92-6c86-42bc (workflow gating)
